verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names an official xAI/Grok SDK package. It shows only adjacent building blocks: an OpenAI-compatible REST API (which implies using a third-party SDK), a gRPC API, a published OpenAPI spec, and quickstart samples in curl, Python and JavaScript that are not identified as first-party SDKs. None of these is the product's own documented SDK, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
